say.variants.default: I wasn't even looking for a fight, {addressee.name}! Now you're dead!
I left you alone and you still swung on me?! Fine, have it your way!
You just crossed a line, {addressee.name}. I'm putting you down!
Shouldn't have attacked me when we could've walked away!
say.variants.shaken: Why are you attacking me?! Stay back! I'll fight if I have to!
I didn't want trouble, {addressee.name}! Get away from me!
Please, back off! You forced my hand!
Don't come any closer! I won't just stand here and die!
say.variants.brave: Big mistake jumping someone who wasn't bothering you!
I minded my own business, {addressee.name}. Now I'm ending yours.
You picked a fight with the wrong survivor today!
Okay then! You started this, and I'm finishing it!
say.variants.aggressive: Thought I was an easy target, huh?! Big mistake!
I was letting you live, {addressee.name}. Bad move swinging first!
You want blood? Fine! Let's see how tough you are!
Should've kept walking! Now I'm taking you apart!
